توضح هذه السياسة كيف تجمع منصة DEV MENU: This policy explains how DEV MENU collects, uses and protects data, in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law.
البيانات التي نجمعها من أصحاب المنشآت: Data we collect from business owners
The business name, type of business and branches.
البريد الإلكتروني، ويُستخدم لتسجيل الدخو: Email address, used to sign in with a verification code and to send invoices and alerts.
رقم الجوال، ويُستخدم للتواصل بخصوص الاشت: Mobile number, used to contact you about your subscription and support.
محتوى المنيو الذي تضيفه: الأطباق والأسعا: The menu content you add: dishes, prices, photos, logo, social links and business information.
لا نطلب من زوار المنيو تسجيل الدخول، ولا: Menu visitors do not sign in, and we do not collect their names or numbers. We only count menu views and dish views anonymously, without linking them to anyone, to show statistics to the business owner. When a visitor chooses "Order via WhatsApp", the chat goes straight to WhatsApp between the visitor and the business and does not pass through our platform.
عند أخذ رقم من البيجر نحفظ رقم الطلب وحا: When a customer takes a pager number, we store the order number and its status, plus the notification subscription in their phone browser or the pager card in their wallet, so they are alerted when their order is ready. We do not ask for their name or number for this. If they keep the pager card, the business may send them messages, and they can remove the card from their wallet at any time.
الاسم ورقم الجوال والجنس، وعدد الأختام و: Name, mobile number and gender, plus stamps, visits and rewards with their dates, and the branch where they happened.
عند الختم بالموقع نستخدم موقع الجوال لحظ: When stamping by location we use the phone location only at that moment to confirm the customer is at the business. We do not store the location itself, only the approximate distance.
الردود على سؤال \"وش أخّرك عنا؟\" إن أجا: Answers to the "What kept you away?" question, if the customer answers it.
هذه البيانات تخص المنشأة التي سجل فيها ا: This data belongs to the business the customer joined. The owner can see it and uses it to serve and contact their customers about their business, and we process it on their behalf.
عند التسجيل في قائمة انتظار إحدى المنشآت: When someone joins a business waitlist, we store the details the business asks for (such as name, mobile number, email and party size) to manage the queue and send confirmation and turn messages. This data belongs to the business, which can view and download it only to serve its guests.
تشغيل الحساب وعرض المنيو والخدمات للعملا: Running accounts and showing the menu and services to customers.
إرسال رموز التحقق والفواتير وتنبيهات الا: Sending verification codes, invoices and subscription alerts.
إرسال الإشعارات ورسائل المنشأة إلى عملائ: Sending notifications and business messages to its customers at the business request.
الدعم الفني وتحسين المنصة وحمايتها من إس: Support, improving the platform and protecting it from misuse.
لا نبيع البيانات ولا نشاركها مع أي جهة ل: We do not sell data or share it with anyone for marketing.
نستعين بمزودي خدمات موثوقين لتشغيل المنص: We rely on trusted service providers to run the platform. They process data only for this purpose, and their servers may be outside Saudi Arabia:
Supabase لقاعدة البيانات وتسجيل الدخول و: Supabase for the database, sign-in and image storage, and Vercel for hosting.
Apple Wallet وGoogle Wallet ومزود إصدار: Apple Wallet, Google Wallet and our wallet pass provider, for loyalty and pager cards.
خدمة البريد الإلكتروني لإرسال الرموز وال: An email service to send codes and invoices.
Anthropic لتشغيل المساعد الذكي عند تفعيل: Anthropic to run the AI assistant when it is turned on. It receives only what is needed to write the message, such as the first name and number of visits, never the mobile number.
تنتقل البيانات عبر اتصال مشفّر، ويقتصر ا: Data travels over an encrypted connection. Access to each business data is limited to its owner, the staff they give a cashier link, and the platform team for support.
نحتفظ ببيانات المنشأة طالما حسابها قائم،: We keep business data while the account exists and for 90 days after the subscription ends, after which we may delete it.
يمكن لصاحب المنشأة طلب حذف حسابه وكل بيا: A business owner can ask for their account and all its data to be permanently deleted at any time, and we delete it within 30 days at most.
يمكن للعميل طلب حذف بطاقته أو بياناته من: A customer can ask the business, or us, to delete their card or data.
الاطلاع على بياناتك والحصول على نسخة منه: To see your data and get a copy of it.
To correct or update your data.
To ask for your data to be deleted.
To withdraw your consent to receiving messages at any time.
